description: This file is a PHP script for managing and displaying execution history of test cases within the TestLink open source test management tool. It initializes the page, fetches execution data, test plans, issues, custom fields, and attachments related to a specific test case, and then renders the information using Smarty templates.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: A generic PHP stdClass object used for flexible data structures.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Handles test case management, including retrieval of execution info and hierarchy.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Manages test project details, including issue tracker settings.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request parameters, returning an object with test case ID and user info.

methods.name: getIssues
methods.description: Fetches issue tracker issues related to test execution IDs.

methods.name: getCustomFields
methods.description: Retrieves custom field values for given test case executions.

methods.name: getAttachments
methods.description: Gathers attachments linked to test case executions.
